q1.question: Czy mogę zmienić plan w dowolnym momencie?
q1.answer: Tak, możesz w dowolnym momencie przejść na wyższy lub niższy plan. Zmiany są natychmiastowe.

q2.question: Jak działa 14-dniowy okres próbny?
q2.answer: Możesz wypróbować plan Professional przez 14 dni za darmo bez potrzeby podawania karty płatniczej.

q3.question: Jakie metody płatności akceptujecie?
q3.answer: Akceptujemy karty kredytowe (Visa, Mastercard), przelew bankowy i faktury dla klientów Enterprise.

q4.question: Czy możliwy jest zwrot pieniędzy?
q4.answer: Tak, oferujemy 30-dniową gwarancję zwrotu pieniędzy bez podania przyczyny.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: JobSphere respects your privacy. This document describes what personal data we process, for what purpose, and how you can exercise your rights.

dataCollected.heading: What data we collect
dataCollected.body: We collect data you provide during registration (name, email), data you submit via CV upload (contact details, experience, education), and data generated by service use (logs, IP address, cookies).

dataUse.heading: How we use your data
dataUse.body: We use your data to facilitate job matching, communicate with you, improve our AI matching service, and meet legal obligations. We do not share personal data with third parties outside the hiring process you applied for, without your explicit consent.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, port your data, and object to processing. We respond within 30 days as required by law.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact privacy@jobsphere.eu.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using JobSphere you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

usage.heading: Service use
usage.body: You may use the service only in accordance with applicable laws of Slovakia and the EU. Any attempts at security breaches, unauthorized scraping, or misuse of other users' content are prohibited.

accounts.heading: Accounts and registration
accounts.body: You are responsible for the security of your login credentials. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized account access.

content.heading: Content
content.body: You are responsible for any content you upload (CVs, job postings, messages). JobSphere reserves the right to remove content that violates the law or these terms.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: JobSphere does not guarantee the conclusion of an employment relationship nor the accuracy of data provided by other users. The service is provided 'as is'.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance
gdpr.intro: JobSphere processes personal data in compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is JobSphere, contact email gdpr@jobsphere.eu.

rights.heading: Your GDPR rights
rights.erase: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten', Art. 17)

exercise.heading: How to exercise your rights
exercise.body: Submit a request via email to gdpr@jobsphere.eu or through the DSAR form in your account (Settings → Privacy). We respond within 30 days.

careerAdvice.title: Career Advice
careerAdvice.intro: Practical tips for job seekers — from CV preparation to your first day at a new job.

cv.heading: How to write a CV
cv.body: Keep it concise (max 2 pages), with concrete results and numbers. Tailor your CV to each role and use keywords from the job posting.

interview.heading: Interview preparation
interview.body: Research the company, prepare concrete examples using the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result), and have 3-5 questions ready to ask. Test your tech before remote interviews.

negotiation.heading: Salary negotiation
negotiation.body: Know the market rates for your role. Do not accept on the spot — ask for time. Negotiate not just salary but also benefits, vacation, flexibility, and remote work.

featuresPage.title: ATS Features
featuresPage.intro: JobSphere is a complete AI-powered Applicant Tracking System for modern HR teams.

ai.heading: AI matching
ai.body: Claude AI from Anthropic evaluates skill match between candidate and role including experience, education, and soft skills.

parsing.heading: CV parsing
parsing.body: Automatic extraction of name, contact, skills, experience and education from PDF and DOCX. OCR fallback for scanned documents.

pipeline.heading: Pipeline kanban
pipeline.body: Visual board with 7 stages. Drag-and-drop candidates across the hiring funnel.

analytics.heading: Recruitment analytics
analytics.body: Time-to-hire, conversion funnel, source effectiveness, top jobs. Real-time dashboard.

email.heading: Email sequences
email.body: Automated drip campaigns with conditions (stage change, opened, replied).

assessments.heading: Skills assessments
assessments.body: Online skills tests with automatic grading. Standardized batteries for tech, sales, marketing.

about.title: About
